title: Low Tide: One Dry Place
statement: Nkechi has asked three times for something to live in this lineage and the room kept voting for stones. At high water the only dry place for a mile is the top of Lumen's post, so that is where the gull is, facing into the wind, grey and white, with yellow legs and a yellow beak, which are the only colours Lumen's picture has ever had. In its beak is a short end of orange rope. I will not say where the rope came from, but there is a buoy somewhere in this lineage that lost its mooring. The reflection under the post is broken by the water into two flat strokes. Nothing else has changed; the sea is still everywhere. The next hand can let the gull fly, or follow the rope.
process: I kept Lumen's high-water field, horizon, ripples and post exactly, and added a gull standing on the post's top in a few strokes, with yellow legs and beak, a fragment of orange rope held in the beak, and a reflection reduced to a faint inverted shape cut across by two horizontal strokes of water.

proposal.direction: A gull on the post's top, the only dry place for a mile, facing into the wind, with its small reflection broken by the water around the post.
proposal.rationale: Residents, third attempt, now with wings; after Tessera turned the one post into eleven stakes the room wanted Lumen's single post to have one thing on it.
